title: How to Build a Booking System Without Code (2026 Guide)
summary: Build a booking system without code in 2026. Customers book a service with a staff member and staff get reminders. 3 steps, other options and the limits.
body_markdown:
A booking system does one job: customers book a service with a staff member, and staff get reminders before each slot. This guide shows one way to build it in Taskade Genesis, three other ways, and when each one is the better fit. To compare the tools side by side, read the[best AI booking systems](https://www.taskade.com/blog/best-ai-booking-systems) .


> **TL;DR:** To build a booking system without code, list your services, staff and open slots, then let a builder make the booking page, the calendar entries and the reminders. Taskade Genesis is one way: clone a working booking app and connect Google Calendar. Free has 3 apps. Pro is $10 a month billed yearly.[See plans and prices](https://www.taskade.com/pricing)


## Quick answer


You can build a booking system without code the same day. Customers pick a service, a staff member and a slot on a public page. Each booking lands in a table, goes to the staff calendar and triggers a reminder. In Taskade, Google Calendar steps need Pro or higher. The full click path is in[Book Classes and Schedule Clients](https://www.taskade.com/learn/genesis/booking-system) .


## Build it in Taskade


Taskade Genesis builds the booking system as a live app: a booking page, tables for services, staff and bookings, an AI agent, and automations. The fastest start is a copy of a working booking app. A copy counts as 1 of the 3 apps on the Free plan. Prompts that build or change the app use[AI credits](https://www.taskade.com/learn/genesis/model-credits) . Free starts with no AI credits, and Pro includes 50,000 a month.


### Step 1: Clone the booking app


[Clone the booking app](https://www.taskade.com/app/appointment-booking-system-te01cx15e4tv558x?action=clone&utm_source=landing_blog&utm_content=build-booking-system) and pick a workspace. Taskade copies the Appointment Booking System, its projects and its agent into that workspace. To start from a blank page instead, describe your business in[Create](https://www.taskade.com/create?entry_kind=content&source=blog&entry=%2Fblog%2Fbuild-booking-system) .


### Step 2: Add your services, staff and open slots


Open the services project in Table view. Add one row for each service, with its duration, its price and the staff member who delivers it. Add the open slots for each staff member. You can make these edits by hand, so they use no AI credits.


### Step 3: Connect the staff calendar and the reminders


Open **Automations** . Connect Google Calendar so that each new booking creates an event on the staff member's calendar. Add a reminder email to the customer and to the staff member before the slot. Ask the AI agent to write the reminder text in your voice. Google Calendar and Gmail steps need Pro or higher.


```text
Customer picks service + staff + slot
|
v
New row in the Bookings table
|
+--> Google Calendar event on the staff calendar
+--> Confirmation email to the customer
+--> Reminder email before the slot


```


When you are done, a test booking from a second browser shows up in the Bookings table and on the staff calendar. Then[publish the app](https://www.taskade.com/learn/genesis/publishing) and share the link. A custom domain needs Pro or higher ([custom domains](https://www.taskade.com/learn/genesis/custom-domains) ).


## Other ways to build a booking system


Three other tools do the same job, and each one is the better fit for a different business. Prices were checked on each vendor's pricing page on 2026-10-18.


Option Free plan Paid from Better fit when


[Calendly](https://calendly.com/pricing) Yes, 1 event type $10 a seat a month (Standard, yearly) You need meeting links for yourself or a small team


[Acuity Scheduling](https://acuityscheduling.com/signup.php) No, 7-day trial $16 a month (Starter, yearly) You take client intake forms and payments for many appointment types


[Square Appointments](https://squareup.com/us/en/appointments/pricing) Yes, you pay card fees $49 a month a location (Plus) You run a salon or a shop and take card payments in person


Taskade Genesis Yes, 3 apps and no AI credits to start $10 a month (Pro, yearly) Bookings also feed a client list, staff work and follow-ups in one app


Calendly is the fastest path when the whole job is "find a time with me." Calendly reads each connected calendar's busy times with no setup. Acuity adds intake forms, packages and payments, which suits coaches, clinics and studios. Square Appointments joins booking to a point-of-sale system, which suits a business that takes payment at the counter.


A custom app earns its place when the booking is the start of the work, not the end. A cleaning company, for example, books a visit, assigns a crew, sends a checklist and follows up for a review. Those steps live in one Taskade app, with the[AI agent](https://www.taskade.com/agents) and the[automations](https://www.taskade.com/automate) in the same place.


## Limitations: when a Taskade booking app is not the right fit


A Taskade Genesis booking app is a strong fit for a service business that wants bookings, staff and follow-ups in one app. Pick a different tool in these cases:


- **You need only one meeting link.** Calendly or a similar scheduler is simpler and has a free plan.
- **You want each staff calendar's busy times to block slots with no setup.** A dedicated scheduler reads free and busy times out of the box. In a Taskade app, you define the open slots in a table, and an automation writes each booking to the calendar.
- **You take most payments at a counter with card hardware.** Square Appointments connects booking to its point-of-sale devices.
- **You want Google Calendar sync on the Free plan.** Google Calendar steps in automations need Pro or higher.

## Frequently Asked Questions


How do I build a booking system without code?


List your services, the staff who deliver them and the open slots. Then use a builder that turns that list into a public booking page, a calendar entry for each booking and a reminder. In Taskade Genesis, clone the Appointment Booking System app, add your services and staff, and connect Google Calendar in an automation. Google Calendar steps need Pro or higher.


Can customers book a specific staff member?


Yes. In a Taskade Genesis booking app, each service row names the staff member who delivers it, and the booking form asks the customer to pick one. An automation then writes the booking to that staff member's Google Calendar and sends the reminder. Calendar steps need Pro or higher.


Is there a free booking system I can build?


Yes. The Taskade Free plan holds 3 apps, and a clone of the booking app counts as one. Free starts with no AI credits, so you edit the clone by hand. Google Calendar and Stripe steps need Pro, which is $10 a month billed yearly with 50,000 AI credits a month. Calendly also has a free plan with 1 event type.


When is Calendly a better choice than a custom booking app?


Calendly is the better choice when you need one meeting link for yourself or a small team, and you want it to read each calendar's busy times with no setup. A custom booking app fits better when bookings also feed a client list, a staff schedule and follow-up work in one place.


How do booking reminders work in Taskade?


An automation runs when a booking arrives. It creates the calendar event, then sends a reminder email to the customer and to the staff member before the slot. The AI agent can write the reminder text in your brand voice. Gmail and Google Calendar steps need Pro or higher.


What does a booking system cost on Taskade?


The Free plan holds 3 apps and starts with no AI credits. Pro is $10 a month billed yearly ($20 monthly), with 50,000 AI credits and 1,000 automation runs a month for up to 10 people, plus up to 10 custom domains. Business is $25 a month billed yearly. The full table is on the pricing page.
